label: Volcano Bottom
literalRoomDescription: You are at the bottom of a large dormant volcano. High above you light enters from the cone of the volcano. The only exit is to the north.
safeSceneProfile: Bottom of dormant volcano, cone light high above and north exit. Balloon is separate; no permanent basket, floating platform or open lava pool.
